outcome: Impact of COVID-19 on IBD antenatal care
finding: Adjustments to IBD antenatal care during the COVID-19 pandemic did not negatively impact patient care, and despite high levels of immunosuppression, only a single COVID-19 infection occurred in the cohort.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section was 43.6%, with 33 elective (12 for IBD indications) and 15 emergency procedures.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery: 38.2 weeks
